content:
In the first 1-3 days my accounts (more than 100) are working fine with watching Reels tool.

After this time instagram adds more menus like "Not personalized" to the menu (I added a screenshot):

https://i.ibb.co/S7JB41jD/reels-search-bar.jpg

The bot is then not able to navigate to reels tab showing error "'NoneType' object is not subscriptable":

The bot then closes the profile and starts the tool again with same result in endless loop.

I added also a video for better understanding:
https://player.vimeo.com/progressive_redirect/playback/1118982086/rendition/1080p/file.mp4?loc=external&log_user=0&signature=d5b1548d2534f09234d5be02c1038fefd1076b8476f2313e8bb0bdcc5acc5a2e
